'''Zenta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] living during the [[Galactic War]] who served as [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] of the [[Inrokini family]].

==Biography==
Zenta was the [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] of the [[Inrokini family]], ruling the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] world of [[Copero/Legends|Copero]]. She had adopted a powerful [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Valss]] into her House and gave him refuge on Copero, allowing him to practice his skills without the threat of death or exile that awaited him otherwise. During the [[war against Zakuul]] Zenta spent some time gathering the secrets of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and in [[3630 BBY]] she harbored an Alliance fugitive [[Theron Shan]] on Copero in exchange for information. However, Shan betrayed her and teamed up Valss, who joined the Human after having experienced a vision of his victory. Together, they stole from Zenta the location of a [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] leading to a superweapon of the Sith Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] which had long been kept in secret on Copero by slicing into her personal datapad.
[[File:Syndic_Zenta_defeated.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Zenta was defeated by Raina Temple and the Alliance Commander.]]
Afterwards, they took Zenta's best fighters and abandoned her to the joint Ascendancy-Alliance team sent by [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Saganu]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] to deal with the rogue Syndic. [[Raina Temple]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] engaged Zenta in combat in the [[Inrokini Stronghold]] and subdued her, after which she explained that she had been duped by Shan just like they had been. Having learned his location, the Commander was about to continue their pursuit, but Saganu demanded that they take Zenta's life, claiming there would be no deal between the Alliance and the Ascendancy otherwise.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zenta appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the second boss during the flashpoint "A Traitor Among the Chiss." Players have the option to send Zenta back to House Inrokini, where she will use her political connection to strike back against the Aristocra; take her prisoner to the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]], which will make other Chiss families furious at Saganu; or kill her, in which case the Ascendancy will officially blame the Alliance, while privately Saganu will offer his support in gratitude.
